title: Persist native board status transitions
description:
As an editor, I want the remaining production board behavior to use canonical CMS contracts.

Feature: Persist native board status transitions
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given an authorized editor viewing a real publication board
    When the editor changes an issue to a permitted native status
    Then the canonical issue and audit history survive reload and unauthorized or stale writes are rejected

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.
